newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-BRAUN RECAPTURES WORLD HEPTATHLON TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BRAUN RECAPTURES WORLD HEPTATHLON TITLE.

text.p: Germany's Sabine Braun recaptured the world heptathlon title on Monday after leading the competition from start to finish.

The 32-year-old 1991 champion, who finished a disappointing seventh at last year's Atlanta Olympics, ended the 800 metres 85 points ahead of her British rival Denise Lewis, the bronze medallist in Atlanta.
European champion Braun totalled 6,739 points with Lewis on 6,654 ahead of bronze medallist Remigia Nazaroviene of Lithuania who finished with 6,566.
Braun went into the 800 with an 82-point lead over Lewis and made sure of victory over Lewis by passing her in the last few strides of the race.
